name: Brasslock Borough
difficulty_label: Hard — confined streets, hinged doors and ricochet patrols
description: Nera Lockstep’s lantern city of enchanted keys and impossible deliveries. Explore locksmith workshops, courier houses, clockmakers, tea rooms and archives across fifteen divided buildings and forty-five working doors. A ghostly last tram traces the southern street. Copper Constables bank shots off masonry; Grate Witches erupt drains in advancing sequences. Face the mobile Lockmaster Regent at the courthouse after clearing the borough.
